Keep raw accounting, qualified physical application, pathway sums, supported resource comparisons and any optional FBA projection distinct.
workflow_expectations: Actual model-selected scientific descendants, source discovery and tool choices, with evaluator expectations outside all episode inputs.
Use the existing shared HPC owner and prediction/execution sisters for native calculations; preserve original bytes, software, scope, result authentication and selected output custody.
A configured resource or path is not an executed result or a numerical receipt.
Trace saved scientific components through typed return and actual parent interpretation.
Inspect actual rendered model inputs and the later interpretation; unrendered context fields or publication alone do not establish model visibility or use.
Missing, conflicting and shared-source results remain qualified; no invented combined confidence scalar.
